Ticket:
Missing lab results feed from Quest

Hello, I am writing because we haven't seen any lab results come through our system from Quest since Tuesday. I checked the integration settings under the administrative tab, and everything looks connected on our end, but the incoming feeds are completely blank when I refresh the diagnostic queue.
